Job Description
CerebriOS is a software company building B2B SaaS products that help businesses make better decisions, streamline operations, and get more value from their data. Our products combine practical business workflows with intuitive technology designed for everyday use. We bring together technology, data, and business expertise to create solutions that are scalable, reliable, and easy to use.
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer to help deliver dependable software across web, mobile, and API-based products. This role combines manual testing with test automation, giving you the opportunity to identify risks early, improve testing processes, and work closely with engineers to prevent defects from reaching customers.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

• 
Review requirements and define acceptance and testing criteria.

• 
Create and execute functional, regression, integration, and exploratory tests.

• 
Document defects with clear, reproducible steps and supporting evidence.

• 
Build and maintain automated UI or API tests.

• 
Validate fixes and monitor recurring quality issues.

• 
Participate in release planning and readiness reviews.

• 
Work with developers to improve application testability.

• 
Maintain test documentation, environments, and test data.

• 
Communicate quality risks to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• 
2+ years of experience in software QA or testing.

• 
Experience testing web, mobile, or API-based applications.

• 
Knowledge of test design and defect-management practices.

• 
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Postman, or browser developer tools.

• 
Strong attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills.

• 
Clear written communication.

NICE TO HAVE

• 
Experience with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium.

• 
Programming experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Java.

• 
Familiarity with CI/CD systems, SQL, and performance testing.

• 
Relevant testing certification such as ISTQB.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
$70,000–$90,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.
CerebriOS offers a remote-first work environment, opportunities to work with modern software testing and automation technologies, and a collaborative culture focused on building reliable products and continuously improving engineering practices.
HIRING PROCESS
Application review → recruiter screen → testing scenario or short role-relevant assessment → final stakeholder interview → offer.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY
CerebriOS is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and consider qualified candidates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Location: Remote
Salary Range: 70,000 - 90,000 USD (gross, annually)

460a74d39c1ab43e.description:
As a Sr. Manager of Field Enablement for North America at Rubrik, you occupy a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of strategy and field execution. Rubrik operates in a hyper-growth environment, and this role is specifically designed to bridge the gap between global corporate strategy and the regional nuances of the North American theater.  This is a remote role located in the United States.  

Role Purpose

The Sr. Manager of Field Enablement (Americas) is an individual contributor role responsible for the productivity and readiness of the sales organization. You will architect and scale enablement programs—from onboarding to advanced value selling—ensuring that Account Executives in these regions are equipped to communicate Rubrik’s Zero Trust Data Security and AI-driven resilience value propositions effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Regional Strategy and Roadmap aligned to Global Enablement programs and programs based on the needs analysis and gaps by Leadership
  • Gap Analysis: Conduct regular assessments of the sales team’s skills and performance to identify regional "readiness gaps."
  • Executive Partnership: Act as the primary strategic partner to the Americas Regional Directors, aligning enablement KPIs with regional revenue targets.
  • Program Development and Delivery
  • Onboarding: Manage a world-class onboarding journey that reduces ramp time for new hires
  • Methodology Mastery: Drive the adoption of Rubrik’s chosen sales methodology (e.g., MEDDICC, Command of the Message) to ensure consistency in pipeline qualification and deal execution.
  • Metrics and Operational Excellence
  • Data-Driven Insights: Track and report on enablement impact via CRM (Salesforce) and Sales Engagement tools (Clari).
  • KPI Ownership: Measure success through metrics such as quota attainment, win rates, and the adoption of new product plays.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years in Sales Enablement, Sales Role, or Sales Leadership within a high-growth SaaS or Cybersecurity environment.
  • Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the North American sales landscape, including regional business practices and the competitive cybersecurity market.
  • Technical Stack: Proficiency with Salesforce, Highspot/Seismic (CMS), and LMS platforms. Experience with AI-assisted coaching tools is a major plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strategic Architect: You don’t just deliver training; you build the systems and frameworks that drive predictable revenue.
  • Communication: Exceptional executive presence; able to act as the "voice of truth" when presenting to senior leadership.
  • Grit and Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the product landscape evolves monthly.
